Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSCondition

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSCondition 0..*EHDSDataSetCondition model

Elements defined in Ancestors:header
EHDSCondition.header
EHDSCondition.header.identifier 0..*IdentifierBusiness identifier for the object, unique within its system. Supporting disambiguation between different contexts (systems/countries).
EHDSCondition.header.version 0..0Version of the resource.
EHDSCondition.header.author[x] 0..*EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSOrganisation, EHDSDeviceAuthor of the resource.
EHDSCondition.header.status 1..1CodeableConceptStatus of the condition/problem, e.g. active, resolved, inactive.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Condition Clinical Status Codes
EHDSCondition.code 1..1CodeableConceptCode identifying the condition, problem or diagnosis.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS (preferred), ICD-10, ICD-O, Orphacode
EHDSCondition.onsetDate 0..1dateTimeEstimated or actual date the problem/condition began.
EHDSCondition.endDate 0..1dateTimeThe date or estimated date that the condition resolved or went into remission.
EHDSCondition.category 0..*CodeableConceptCategory of the problem (e.g. POA – present on admission, hospital-acquired condition (HAC) and other categorisations).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS
EHDSCondition.resolutionCircumstances 0..1stringDescribes the reason for which the status of the problem changed from current to inactive (e.g. surgical procedure, medical treatment).
EHDSCondition.severity 0..1CodeableConceptA subjective assessment of the severity of the condition.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS
EHDSCondition.bodySite 0..*EHDSBodyStructureThe anatomical location including laterality where this condition manifests itself.
EHDSCondition.stage 0..*CodeableConceptStage or grade, usually assessed formally using a specific staging, grading or classification system, such as Tumor, Node, Metastasis (TNM), International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O) or Breast Imaging Reporting and Data Systems (BI-RADS). Multiple assessment systems may be used.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: Not defined
EHDSCondition.diagnosisAssertionStatus 0..1CodeableConceptAssertion about the certainty associated with a diagnosis. Evidence of condition (diagnostic, clinical or both).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Condition Verification Status
EHDSCondition.specialistContact 0..*EHDSHealthProfessionalHealth professional who may be specifically related to the problem, as a preferred contact.
EHDSCondition.externalResource 0..*uriExternal resource which may be specifically related to the problem, for example a link to a guideline on a specific rare disease problem.
EHDSCondition.note 0..1stringFree text note by the health professional.
